/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
ben = pd.read_csv('beneficiaries.csv')
payments = pd.read_excel('payments.xlsx', header=4)

# Clean
ben_ids = ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
payments['Beneficiary ID'] = payments['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
payments['Status'] = payments['Status'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Filter paid
paid_mask = payments['Status'].str.lower() == 'paid'
paid_payments = payments[paid_mask]

# Exclude payment rows whose Beneficiary ID is absent from CSV
valid_ids = set(ben_ids)
paid_payments = paid_payments[paid_payments['Beneficiary ID'].isin(valid_ids)]

# Beneficiaries with at least one paid payment
beneficiaries_with_paid = set(paid_payments['Beneficiary ID'].unique())

total_beneficiaries = ben_ids.nunique()
num_with_paid = len(beneficiaries_with_paid)

percentage = (num_with_paid / total_beneficiaries * 100) if total_beneficiaries else 0
print('total', total_beneficiaries)
print('with paid', num_with_paid)
print('percentage', percentage)
\""
